identity.sibling_rule: equal recipe digests AND one clause-digest set contained in the other (equality included); groups are connected components of that relation
transformations_that_must_not_create_a_g: cumulative clause-only growth from one recipe
refusals: scenario absent or not a lower-case slug
declared scenario absent from the record's own rendered prompt
input.output_contract missing, or its fields array empty
a clause section that is not an array
duplicate case id inside the axis
identity.residual_limitation: lexical, not semantic: two records sharing a recipe whose clause sets merely overlap without containment are counted as two groups, so re-authored (not appended) clauses can still buy a group

mirror_assertion: this spec .identity block equals swarm.evals.g13_semantic_group.group_axis_identity(), asserted by tests/evals/test_task_pool_freeze_v2.py

why_this_axis_exists.problem: g13-independence-checker-v2 compares strings. A scenario rename, a numeric substitution or an appended clause produces a string it has never seen while producing no new information, so fifteen re-skins of one recipe pass all eight of its axes as fifteen independent records.
why_this_axis_exists.consequence: a Wilson bound over those fifteen records counts one observation fifteen times and overstates confidence, which is v1 blocker B3 at a level string equality cannot see
why_this_axis_exists.remedy: count distinct semantic groups per required cell, not distinct records, and floor that count at fifteen

relationship_to_the_independence_checker.stacking: additive: every id, payload-digest, prompt-digest and normalised-template invariant of g13-independence-checker-v2 still runs unchanged, and this axis fails the freeze on top of them

why_the_declared_scenario_cannot_inflate: erasing a token can only make two records look more alike, so it can only merge groups and never split them. The vocabulary erased from every record is the corpus-wide union of every declared scenario slug, not just the record's own, so a record cannot manufacture a group by declaring a convenient scenario. A record whose declared scenario does not occur in its own rendered prompt is refused outright.
